terms.title: Terms and privacy
terms.intro: This page explains what the app does with your data. It is not legal advice.
terms.data.title: What we store
terms.data.body: Your name, WhatsApp number and the area you type, plus the meal's coordinates so we can show it to people nearby.
terms.privacy.title: What is never shown
terms.privacy.body: Your coordinates are never returned to anyone, and the account's email and password never leave the server.
terms.content.title: Your content
terms.content.body: Meal photos and descriptions are yours; keeping them accurate is your responsibility.
terms.handoff.title: Contact
terms.handoff.body: When you message a cook we hand you to WhatsApp. What happens next is between you.
terms.account.title: The account
terms.account.body: No sign-up, no SMS. The account lives on your device; deleting the app can lose ownership of your meals.
contact.title: Contact us
contact.body: For problems with the app itself, talk to us. For a meal, use the WhatsApp button on the meal page.
contact.none: The support channel is not open yet
